summary: The web app's unmounted workspace tab model declares its subjects and commands as Effect Schema tagged unions, reports a tab-kind claim conflict as a tagged error, and persists through Effect's browser key-value store; adds @effect/platform-browser 4.1.0

replay.detail: Web modules only; no replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No server storage changes. The device-local tab document keeps the caller's localStorage key and the same JSON encoding of WorkspaceState, now written through KeyValueStore.toSchemaStore; a test reads a document the earlier plain JSON codec wrote. No app code mounts the store yet, so no browser reads or writes it.

compatibility.detail: Adds the @effect/platform-browser 4.1.0 dependency to apps/fractal-web (pnpm lock, Buck sha256 pin, licenses and nix/typescript-client-deps.hash updated). The workspace module's TypeScript surface changes: WorkspaceStorage is now a key plus a change stream over a KeyValueStore layer, makeKindRegistry throws TabKindClaimConflict, and Subject, Command, Drop and ReceivedLayout are exported as schemas. No module outside src/workspace imports them; no runtime, wire or client changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the hand-written unions and the direct localStorage store and removes the dependency; a document either version wrote stays readable by the other.
